attributes.recent_signatures: newest transaction signatures of a wallet returned by the chain RPC (one bounded page, newest first): list of {signature, slot, block_time (ISO UTC or null), failed (the transaction errored), confirmation_status}; memos, counterparties and amounts are never kept
attributes.more_history: bool: the bounded history page came back full, so older activity may exist (the oldest date read is then not the first activity)
attributes.rpc_context: chain RPC that answered and the context of its answer: {host, internal (organisation-operated node), slot, api_version, node, ratelimit_tier}
